scholarships.organization: Thurgood Marshall College Fund (TMCF) — Open Scholarships Portal
scholarships.description: Howard is a TMCF member school, so Mason can create a TMCF Scholar profile and get auto-matched to dozens of corporate-sponsored scholarships (Wells Fargo Access/Gap Scholarships, Acushnet Company Scholarship, and more) that rotate through TMCF's portal each cycle.

Create a profile on the TMCF Scholarship Portal
Individual sponsor awards vary — filter by business/finance and sophomore standing once logged in

scholarships.deadlineNote: Confirmed: the 2026-2027 Wells Fargo Gap Scholarship (need-based, all majors, freshman–senior, 2.75+ GPA, up to $1,000) is open now and closes Dec 1, 2026 — the best current match since it isn't STEM-restricted. The separate Wells Fargo Access Scholarship (up to $10,000) opened June 1–July 17, 2026 but is STEM-majors-only, so not a fit for Finance. Updated Oct 4, 2026: the TMCF | FedEx HBCU Scholarship track (up to $9,600, business majors specifically, 2.75+ GPA, all class years, TMCF member school required) had a confirmed 2026-2027 deadline of July 17, 2026, which has now passed — estimate ~July 2027 for the next wave. The TMCF | MUFG Scholarship ($11,500, 3.0+ GPA, all majors, need-based, 2-minute video essay) already closed for this academic year (window was March 16–Apr 24, 2026) — bookmark for a spring 2027 reopening. Updated Oct 6, 2026: also confirmed the TMCF | Lowe's Gap Scholarship (up to $5,000, Business OR STEM majors, no class-year restriction) is open now with the same Dec 1, 2026 close as Wells Fargo Gap — a second live, directly-eligible match this wave. The TMCF | CoBank Scholarship (up to $10,250, need-based, explicitly names Finance/Banking as eligible majors, sophomores eligible, 3.0+ GPA) looks like the single best-matched sponsor award on paper. Updated Oct 7, 2026: confirmed directly via tmcf.org that the 2026-2027 CoBank cycle ran two waves — Wave 1 closed Jan 16, 2026 and Wave 2 closed Apr 24, 2026 — both now passed, with no Wave 3 found; watch for the 2027-2028 cycle to open around the same Jan/Mar pattern. The TMCF | Sprott Inc. HBCU Scholarship and TMCF | Verisk Scholarship (both name Business/Finance) already closed their Wave 2 window (Mar 9–Apr 24, 2026); Verisk is junior/senior-only going forward anyway. Recheck the portal after Dec 1, 2026 for a new wave.
